name: Raid on the Kolkar
label: Quest

intro: After Strange Alliance, Uthek the Wise sends you against the Kolkar centaurs to the northeast. Kill them, take their charms, and bring ten of those charms back to Uthek.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Kolkar centaurs think their magic is strong. They do not know magic! They would not know magic if it bit them!
You will show them their magic is weak. Go to the Kolkar to the northeast and kill them. Take their charms. Bring me the charms and I will throw them in the fire and laugh!

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have the charms? You showed the Kolkar they are weak?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You do a good thing for the Gelkis. The Kolkar are weak and will die. Their magic is pathetic and will not save them. You showed them this, and their fear will make them even more feeble!
And in our lands, the feeble soon die.
